transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... well, my eating habits just sort of fell apart recently. I usually track everything pretty closely for work and fitness, but I just stopped caring. I think I went a few days just having coffee and maybe a protein bar here and there. I didn't even really notice until my clothes started fitting loose.
Did you want to lose weight when this change in your eating habits started?
No... not really. I wasn't trying to lose weight. I just... didn't think about food much. That's all.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No. Like I said, I just... wasn't thinking about it. I don't care about gaining weight. I just wasn't hungry.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I suppose so. I haven't stepped on a scale or anything. Just... like I said earlier, my clothes are hanging pretty loose on me now. So, yeah. Probably.
Are you afraid of eating?
No. I just... I told you, I'm just not hungry. That's it.
Do you feel anxious when you think about eating?
No. I just don't have an appetite. It's not anxiety, I just... don't want to eat.
Do you still enjoy the taste of food when you do eat?
I don't really know. I guess it tastes fine. I haven't exactly been paying attention to it... it's just food.
Have you noticed a decrease in enjoyment of activities you usually like to do?

Yeah. I guess so. I just... haven't really wanted to do much of anything. Like hiking, or... editing photos. I even stopped logging my meals. 

There's a woodworking project out in the garage I haven't touched either. It's kind of strange, I guess, because usually that stuff keeps me grounded. But... yeah, I just haven't wanted to.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

Yeah. I guess so. Um... it got bad after a project sponsor at work questioned my judgment. After that, it just felt like... the bottom dropped out. I just sat in my apartment. Feeling pretty hollow. Ashamed, I guess. It's stupid, but... I was even crying over basic work emails that I normally would have just handled. So... yeah.
Did you start feeling sad and depressed before or after you stopped wanting to eat?
I'm not really sure. I wasn't... keeping track of the exact timeline. It all just kind of blurred together, I guess.
Did your feelings of sadness and depression start before, after, or around the same time you stopped wanting to eat?
I... like I just said, I really don't know. Maybe around the same time? I just wasn't paying attention to which one happened first.
Has your weight loss been so significant that other people have noticed or commented on it?

Yeah, I guess they have. Um... I stopped caring about tracking my food. I'd just... skip meals for days. Mostly just having coffee and protein bars. And... yeah, my clothes started hanging loose on me before I even realized it.
Do you think you would have started eating normally again if you hadn't been feeling sad and depressed?
I... I'm not sure. It's hard to say what I would have done. I just... I really don't know how to answer that. I just know I didn't want to eat.
Did you ever try to eat but found you just weren't able to because you weren't hungry, or did you sometimes think about eating but chose not to?
I don't really know. I just... didn't eat. I wasn't really paying attention to whether I was hungry or making some kind of choice about it. It just didn't happen.
Did you want to lose weight at any point during this time?
No. I wasn't... trying to do that. It wasn't about losing weight.
Did you feel like you were making a choice not to eat, or did you simply not think about food?

I... I don't think it was a choice. I just stopped caring about it. I usually track my food, but that went out the window. I'd go days just having coffee... maybe a protein bar. I didn't even realize how bad it was until my clothes started hanging off me. I just... wasn't eating real meals.
Did you feel like you were avoiding food or just not interested in eating when you weren't eating?
Just not interested. I wasn't avoiding it... my eating just went completely off the rails. Like I said, I just didn't care.
Did you feel like something was preventing you from eating when you weren't eating, or was it just that you didn't want to?

No, nothing was preventing me. I just... didn't want to. Like I told you, I just stopped caring about real meals and lived on coffee for days. I didn't even notice what was happening until my clothes were loose.
Is your weight loss something that worries you now?
I don't know. I guess... not really. It just is what it is.
Do you think your lack of interest in eating would have happened if you weren't feeling sad and depressed?
I don't really know. I guess... probably not. I haven't really thought about it.
